# Plugin marketplace review guidelines

Listing PRs now land in **[almasix-dev/orbit-plugins](https://github.com/almasix-dev/orbit-plugins)**.

Maintainer review notes live there:

- [PLUGIN_REVIEW_GUIDELINES.md](https://github.com/almasix-dev/orbit-plugins/blob/main/.github/PLUGIN_REVIEW_GUIDELINES.md)
- [plugin PR template](https://github.com/almasix-dev/orbit-plugins/blob/main/.github/PULL_REQUEST_TEMPLATE/plugin.md)

Authors should read [Get listed](https://orbit.almasix.com/plugins/get-listed/) and
[Listing guidelines](https://orbit.almasix.com/plugins/guidelines/).

The public catalog UI remains in this repository (`docs/src/pages/plugins/**`).
Docs builds sync the registry via `npm run marketplace:sync`.
